summary: Tested both requests end to end in preview with 3 TEST_I163 orgs (BRONZE+subscription, SILVER+planner org grant, BRONZE without sub), all deleted at the end. REQUEST B (Event Map annual subscription): summary, Stripe TEST checkout (mode=subscription, 2900 cents yearly recurring, same price_id reused and saved in marketplace_services.eventmap_prices.<mode>.yearly), pending grant gives no access, active org grant gives rights on ALL events, and checkout is then rejected with 'già attivo'. Marketplace card/detail at 1920 and 390: price, mode and description OK; SILVER shows 'Attiva inclusa' + subscription, BRONZE shows the price line + addon-buy-submit, BRONZE with an active sub shows 'Abbonamento Event Map attivo'. REQUEST A Event Map: video groups (credit consumed once; v2..v7 free; 409 confirm_first_download; confirm -> definitivo with first_download {at,by,version_id,version}; 403 video_final; re-download free; org admin unlock 403; SA unlock/restore OK; SA download does not finalize; history kept), UI archive (MODIFICABILE/DEFINITIVO, 'Modifica e rigenera' -> banner + 'Rigenera video (senza crediti)', first-download dialog cancel/confirm, note) and the 'Pausa ai ristori' UI (autosave, custom 7 s + auto persisted after reload, 15 s/3x3 s warning -> 'Usa 30 secondi' sets 30). Real MP4s rendered: 16:9 30 s p3, 9:16 60 s p5+auto, 1:1 15 s p3, 1:1 15 s p0, 16:9 15 s without aids. Frame analysis: 3 clean stops of ~3 s / ~5 s where the km counter and elevation marker stay still and the 'RISTORO · KM x' box is readable above the cursor without covering the chart; motion resumes; p0 and no-aid videos move continuously. Preview JPEG OK. Event Planner BOM: API + UI (auto rows, read-only map qty, total=max(0,map+adj), edits persist without duplicates after reload, manual add/delete, components 5/5/20 with parent row replaced, filters, event summary with per-project columns, XLSX G=MAX(0,E+F) and event SUM formula, PDF/inline PDF valid %PDF even with '&' and '<' in notes, duplicate copies the BOM independently, cross-org 403/404). Planner auto-fit could NOT be verified visually because the MapLibre canvas was blank in headless Chromium (code reviewed only).

minor.issue: Any key is accepted (e.g. '$bad' -> 200) and creates a phantom BOM row (compute() line 89 adds every override key that does not start with m: and has no ::). The key should be checked against map items, components or manual ids (planner_bom.py:196-206).

ER.timing() (eventmap_render.py:48) counts every aid station, but Renderer._timeline only stops at 0 < m < total (line 420). An aid at the start or at the finish ('Ristoro Arrivo') adds to pause_s and can trigger a warning or suggestion although the MP4 never pauses there. Filter the aids the same way in both places.

When components are defined for a type, the parent row's code, supplier, notes, status and rettifica are dropped without any warning (planner_bom.py:92-95). Consider copying supplier and status onto the component rows, or warning in the editor.

integration_issues.issue: bom-print opens a popup that was still about:blank when checked. Whether the inline PDF loads afterwards was not verified in headless; check manually.

Could not be verified: the map canvas stayed blank in headless (no tiles or objects drawn). PlannerMap.jsx fit() logic was reviewed and looks correct (fitReq bumps on project load and the planner-fit-all click; single point -> zoom 18; empty -> no-op).

issues: The price is shown as '€29,00/anno' (mkt-card-price / mkt-detail-price) while the buy area shows '29,00 €/anno' and the Event Planner card shows 'Da 29 €/mese'. Use one Italian format, e.g. '29 €/anno'.
EventMapStudio.jsx:234 em-no-videos still says 'Hai esaurito i video disponibili: acquista un pacchetto'. Packages are no longer sold; mention the subscription or the yearly renewal instead.
In the 1:1 15 s video with 3x3 s pauses, the cursor moves for only about 0.7 s between stops. This is warned in the UI, but it is the expected outcome if the user ignores the warning.
The Codice column is narrow, so codes are cut off ('STR-COPERTU', 'VIA-TRANSEN').

action_items: Update stale regression tests/test_eventmap_races.py::test_race_video_versions_and_credits (and the dependent test_download_name / test_delete_race_keeps_tracks_and_videos). It expects a second POST /races/{rid}/videos to give version 2 and consume a 2nd credit, but under the new design each POST creates a new group. Use POST /video-groups/{gid}/versions for v2, and download with confirm=1.
Make the ER.timing aid filter match _timeline (0 < m < total)
Validate the BOM row key in PUT /bom/rows/{key}
Unify the Event Map price format (card/detail vs buy area)
Replace the 'acquista un pacchetto' wording in EventMapStudio.jsx:234
critical_code_review_comments: eventmap.py _enqueue/_process: credit-once-per-group logic is sound (videos_in_progress excludes regen; credit_consumed set atomically). A group whose first version failed stays with current_version_id None and is never cleaned up: consider hiding or removing empty groups.
eventmap.py video_file: finalization uses an atomic update on status=modificabile, so simultaneous first downloads are safe. Inline playback does not finalize (verified).
addons.py handle_webhook: the renewal adds videos_total only when expires_at moves to a later date; the comment at line 501 still says 'Event Planner' only.

Backend hot reload also watches /app/backend/tests: editing a test file while a video renders restarts uvicorn, and ensure() marks the in-progress videos as error. This caused one spurious regression failure during this run.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the new iter163 suite (11/11); regression: addons 10/10, planner_org_scope OK, eventmap_races 10/13 (3 stale tests, see action items)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all tested flows work; planner fit not visually verifiable, print popup not verified)

seed_data_creation: TEST_I163 Br/Si/B2 orgs with events, tracks, races, videos, BOMs and grants were created and deleted via the SA org-delete endpoint (verified 0 left). 4 open Stripe TEST checkout sessions with metadata product=eventmap were expired; one may belong to another concurrent test run, all in TEST mode. Stripe price price_1UbjRR5H9IaGnKbkah0ruYEN (29 €/year) is now saved in marketplace_services.eventmap_prices.test.yearly as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: export MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/STRIPE_SECRET_KEY from backend/.env plus REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; pytest tests/test_iter163_em_sub_bom.py -n 0. BRONZE allows 1 event, so create events before setting the plan. Dismiss the welcome-demo dialog ('Non ora') and the cookie banner ('Accept all') in Playwright. Do not edit files under backend/ while renders run (hot reload kills jobs). Frame-analysis helper: /tmp/frames.py (imageio_ffmpeg, 4 fps, mean-diff detects pauses).
rca of the issue: eventmap_races failures: semantic change (a new POST creates a new group; versions now go through /video-groups/{gid}/versions), not a product bug. The first run also hit a hot-reload restart triggered by a test-file edit.
